notes:
Swipe left or right over Live TV on touch devices to switch to the next or previous channel. Vertical brightness and volume gestures and guide swipes remain available.

On TV, press Back from a movie poster to jump to the filters. Press Down from the bottom filter row to return to the same movie and scroll position. Choosing a filter starts at the first result; Back from the filters returns to Live TV. Open dialogs and dropdowns close first.

Improved Android TV Back handling to preserve the focused movie or filter. Tested on a Samsung Galaxy S9+ and a Panasonic TV.
